Perikleous E8

Studio, 33 m², Perikleous 13, Athens

About this suite

A 33 m² studio built around a private jacuzzi beside a large window. A black slatted partition divides the bed from the seating area, and the kitchenette and walk-in shower complete the space. In the distance the Acropolis can be seen from the jacuzzi window, lit up at night.

From the jacuzzi window you can see the Acropolis in the distance, lit up in the evening.
